verdict.rationale: Galileo exposes substantial programmatic surface: a Python SDK for logging traces and spans (with an sdk-api docs section), OTel-based distributed tracing, and an official MCP server that covers creating and managing datasets, running experiments, and setting up prompt templates. Nothing documents that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a public REST API reference/OpenAPI spec, and evidence that UI-centric features (alerts, annotation queues, AI Assistant, Luna distillation, continuous metric feedback) are reachable via API.
